seo.title: American Legation Tangier | Museum in the Medina | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: The American Legation in Tangier is a historic US diplomatic building turned museum — art, archives and a calm courtyard inside the medina.
seo.keywords: American Legation Tangier, Tangier museum, US Legation Morocco

name: American Legation
hero_subtitle: Historic museum in the medina lanes.

overview.title: A quiet diplomatic chapter in the old town
overview.p1: The Tangier American Legation is the first American public property outside the United States, now a museum of art and history inside the medina. Courtyards and rooms offer a calmer rhythm than the market streets outside.
overview.p2: Check opening days before you go. It pairs well with a medina walk rather than a rushed tick-box stop.

1.title: Quiet galleries
1.desc: Best chance for a calmer walk through the rooms.

2.title: Courtyard pause
2.desc: Shade and history in the middle of the medina loop.

3.title: Cultural stop
3.desc: Easy to fit after Petit Socco or before the kasbah climb.

food.title: Eat nearby
food.p1: No full café inside as a main reason to come — use Petit Socco or medina kitchens before or after.
food.li3: Port seafood a short walk away.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Inside the medina — follow maps or ask toward the American Legation / Legation museum.

2.title: Hours
2.desc: Verify opening days and times; they can vary.

3.title: Pace
3.desc: Allow time for rooms and courtyard, not only a photo at the door.

q1.question: Is it still a diplomatic office?
q1.answer: It functions as a museum and cultural centre today, with deep historic ties to US–Morocco relations.

q3.question: How long to spend?
q3.answer: Forty-five to ninety minutes suits most visitors.

q4.question: Hard to find?
q4.answer: Medina navigation helps; save the location offline or ask locally.

q5.question: Good for non-history fans?
q5.answer: The courtyard and setting alone are a peaceful contrast to busier lanes.
